title: Days 239–252 local HomeSecure policy evaluation and fake-adapter controls
scope: One offline synthetic HomeSecure policy-explanation evaluation context (synthetic customer cust-synth-01, owner synthetic-owner-a). Extend fixed evaluation for exact source citations, abstention, owner isolation, malicious retrieved instructions, deterministic latency, token/call cost estimates, bounded fake-provider timeout/retry and redacted trace correlation. Paired deterministic baseline and scripted fake adapter only; no live provider, network, cloud, real customer, personal data, consequential eligibility decision, external exposure, credentials, paid exams or booking.
gate: Run python3 scripts/check_continuation_239_entry_gate.py. The read-only gate requires both the learner-owned Day 210 boundary record and a future Day 238 learner-owned closeout record whose fields record synthetic draft creation, pre-approval abstention, explicit human review, same-owner exact-text exposure, and unchanged policy snapshot. Missing is not_met; malformed is blocked. Eligible permits an attempt only and awards no completion. If blocked, project practice uses the first unmet existing CoverStory recovery selector and AI practice stays instructor-only on fixed offline fixtures; do not run this window learner acceptance selectors.

tasks.project_task: Implement and test the versioned fixture, paired results, caveats and recovery seam using the complete offline evaluation pipeline and independently fixed paired metrics. If either entry gate is blocked, project minutes go to the first unmet CoverStory recovery selector.
tasks.ai_task: Run every fixed case through the scripted fake adapter and evaluator; compare per-case outcomes and all paired metrics against independent expected values, then exercise a counterfactual mutation. No provider or cloud calls.
tasks.milestone: versioned fixture, paired results, caveats and recovery

project_implementation_tests.task: Implement and test the complete pipeline paired outcomes and independent metric oracle seam in the existing synthetic policy path. If either entry gate is blocked, project minutes go to the first unmet CoverStory recovery selector.
project_implementation_tests.command: python3 scripts/check_continuation_239_entry_gate.py; if blocked, run the first unmet selector from this plan's recovery_selectors; if eligible, run `python3 -m unittest ai.grounded.learner_acceptance.test_continuation_239.Continuation239Acceptance.test_day252_reports_known_blind_spots_without_claiming_real_customer_outcomes`.
project_implementation_tests.evidence: Exact selector/result, state before/after, changed paths and first failing assertion; no completion inference.

ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.task: Run every fixed case through the scripted fake adapter and evaluator; compare per-case outcomes and all paired metrics against independent expected values, then exercise a counterfactual mutation. No provider or cloud calls.
ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.command: `python3 -m unittest ai.grounded.learner_acceptance.test_continuation_239.Continuation239Acceptance.test_day252_reports_known_blind_spots_without_claiming_real_customer_outcomes` only after both entry gates are eligible; keep expected labels independent of provider output.
ai_workflow_implementation_evaluation.evidence: Exact per-case outputs, full paired metric vector, denominator, known blind spots, and a counterfactual mutation result.

certification_labs_questions.task: Offline retrieval question on versioned fixture, paired results, caveats and recovery, mapped to Review the exam guide; no paid lab.
certification_labs_questions.command: Open https://aws.amazon.com/certification/certified-developer-associate/ and answer one locally written question against exact heading `Review the exam guide`; no exam or service calls.
certification_labs_questions.evidence: Exact currently published guide version, heading, checked answer and one gap; no pass/readiness claim.

ai_concept_source_study.task: Study Evaluation best practices — Design your eval process and connect one principle to versioned fixture, paired results, caveats and recovery.
ai_concept_source_study.command: Open https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/evaluation-best-practices at `Design your eval process`; record one application and one limitation.
ai_concept_source_study.evidence: Exact page title/section and one concept/limitation note; no API or service call.

certification_domain_study.task: Study AWS Certified Developer - Associate — Review the exam guide; recheck currently published version.
certification_domain_study.command: Open https://aws.amazon.com/certification/certified-developer-associate/ and verify exact current guide/version plus `Review the exam guide`.
certification_domain_study.evidence: Guide/version, exact heading, one mapped concept and limit; readiness is not guaranteed.

core_systems_security_cloud_study.task: Study json — JSON encoder and decoder — Basic Usage as a local-only design comparison.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.command: Read https://docs.python.org/3/library/json.html heading `Basic Usage`; record one implementation implication and boundary.
core_systems_security_cloud_study.evidence: Exact title/heading and implication/boundary; no cloud use or deployment claim.

evidence.task: Record only work actually attempted and observed.
evidence.command: Record source commit SHA and artifact SHA-256 separately; capture exact commands, outputs, paths, assistance and blockers.
evidence.evidence: Future learner entry only when actually earned: 40-hex source SHA, 64-hex artifact SHA, actual status and next step. Scaffold CI never marks learner completion.

tasks.shared_task: 45 minutes: review existing notes or acceptance output; identify the first unmet invariant and next selector. No capstone design proposal or post-hoc justification.

shared_allocation.rule: Exactly one shared 45-minute block per day; system design only from the separate interview question bank.

synthetic_context.notice: All entities, policies, dates and outcomes are invented local fixture values. No customer or provider outcome claim.
